definitions.ask: On a req, drawer header, or note bullet, should Ctrl+Shift+O open a child of that line?
definitions.why: Keeps Ctrl+Shift+O useful for nesting a sub-note and matches today's Vim-normal habit

choices.label: Req, drawer, and note lines get a child after their children; headlines use the note home
Every line inside a task block opens at the owning task's note home

definitions.ask: Should `o` on a `^prj` headline add a completion-criterion req under the `^prj` line?
definitions.why: One rule for every task headline, as requested; `O` still opens the intake row

choices.label: `o` adds a req under the `^prj` line like any headline; `O` keeps the `## Tasks` intake row
`o` and `O` on `^prj` both keep opening a new task at the `## Tasks` intake
